page.overview:
What is Mt. Falgabard?

Mt. Falgabard is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It lies between the Cave of Dread and Castle Falgabard.

The Warriors of Darkness have to go through here to reach Castle Falgabard. With Graham in the party, they finally make it.
